name: Zettai Fukujuu Crisis
source:
One day, due to a small twist of fate, the protagonist has his weakness seized by a gloomy girl named Hakamada Miya.

Taking full advantage of the hold she has over him, she begins demanding perverted acts outdoors on a daily basis.

Refusal means ruin.

Yet though their relationship is grim at first, it gradually turns into an affection - and before long, the power dynamic between them reverses.

From the one being violated... to the one violating.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ293809.html]DLsite[/url]]
